About Me

Professional Profile

I am an Electrical Engineer with an Executive MBA in Finance, bringing a unique blend of technical engineering knowledge and solid business & financial understanding to complex infrastructure projects.

My recent focus has been on large-scale power plant projects, where I have managed administrative operations, vendor coordination, billing documentation, insurance arrangements, and stakeholder communication with project owners such as the Bangladesh Power Development Board (BPDB).

I thrive in high-pressure, multi-tasking environments and am comfortable bridging technical, commercial, and administrative functions to keep projects moving forward smoothly.

Experience & Education

Key professional engagement and academic background.

Saidpur 150 MW + 10% Simple Cycle Power Plant Project

Ongoing · Defect Liability until Sep 2027

Administrative & Project Support Operations · Dhaka Office

ECA financing project under the ownership of Bangladesh Power Development Board (BPDB). Total project cost: USD 83.5 million. EPC Contractor: Dongfang Electric International Corporation (DEC). Commercial operation achieved in December 2025.

  • Oversaw all administrative operations at the Dhaka office in close coordination with the BPDB Project Director.
  • Liaised with vendors and suppliers for procurement of equipment and materials.
  • Coordinated with certified testing laboratories for material testing related to construction and commissioning.
  • Prepared invoices and complete documentation for civil works, erection, commissioning, and shipments to support billing claims to BPDB.
  • Engaged in regular discussions with Project Director and Deputy Project Director of BPDB to resolve disputed issues and provided timely updates to management.
  • Drafted and submitted official correspondence and letters supporting project progress.
  • Arranged insurance cover notes and policies in collaboration with government non-life insurance company for shipments and project assets.
  • Collaborated across departments to support successful project completion.
